episode_summary: This episode of Keeping It Real with Austin Clarence explores the impact of global oil prices on mortgage rates and offers insights into specialty mortgage programs for specific professions. It also discusses current trends in home values, the Federal Reserve's influence on interest rates, and opportunities in VA and FHA loans. Listeners will gain actionable strategies to better serve clients and differentiate themselves in the market.
